description: This file defines a store using the Pinia library for state management in a Vue.js application. The store manages manufacturing cycle time (MCT) data, including state variables, getters, and actions for calculating and updating times related to manufacturing operations.

methods.name: calculateProductMCT
methods.description: Calculates the total manufacturing cycle time (MCT) for a product by summing various operation times.

methods.name: updateTimeDistribution
methods.description: Updates the time distribution array based on a list of operations by summing individual time components.
